name: Cybercore Web
summary: Black grounds, acid-green or cyan accents, chrome, angular cuts, HUD frames, small caps data labels and glitch. It mixes 1990s cyber fiction with techwear, and it feels like a machine interface.

philosophy.core_thesis: The page is a machine interface: sharp, labelled, cold and dense with data.
design_principles: Set the ground at #05070A and use 1 acid accent (#C6FF00 or #00F0FF) on no more than 10% of the surface.
Cut corners at 45° with a clip-path of 8px to 16px on cards and buttons; set radius to 0px elsewhere.
Frame panels with a 1px line in the accent at 40% and add 4 corner ticks of 8px to 12px.
Set data labels at 10px to 12px in upper case with tracking of +0.12em to +0.2em in a mono or a wide display face.
Add a glitch on hover: offset the text layers by 2px to 4px in cyan and magenta for 120ms to 200ms.
Overlay scanlines of 2px at 6% to 10% opacity and a grain of 3% to 5%.
Add 3 or more HUD data items per screen: a code, a coordinate, a version number or a timer.
anti_patterns: Large empty areas without any data label

layout.grid_mechanics: A strict 12-column grid with 16px gutters; panels of unequal size are cut at corners; HUD labels sit on the edge of panels.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 15% to 25% of the surface is empty; the spacing scale is 4, 8, 16, 32 and 64px.
layout.alignment_rules: Flush left; data right-aligned in mono columns; headlines are wide and may bleed off the edge.
layout.container_geometry: Rectangles with 45° cuts of 8px to 16px; thin 1px frames; no radius.

font_pairings.note: A wide, angular display for headlines.
A squared grotesque with a technical voice.
A cut-corner face that echoes the clipped panels.

hierarchy_rules: Use three weights: regular (400), semibold (600) and bold (700).
Set labels and nav in upper case.
Set numbers and codes in a mono face.

color.palette_structure: Near-black ground with one acid accent, chrome greys and an alert colour.
color.contrast_rules: Chrome on void holds at least 12:1; the acid accent marks actions and one data value per panel.
color.surface_treatment: Flat black with a scanline overlay and a grain; gradients only as a glow behind the hero object.
color.light_and_shadow: Light is emitted: glows of 8px to 24px blur in the accent at 30% to 50%.

materiality.surface_simulation: Anodised metal and glass screens in the dark.
materiality.border_rules: 1px accent line at 40% with 4 corner ticks.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: Glow 8px to 24px in the accent; no soft shadow; clip-path cuts.

ornamentation_details.iconography: 1.5px square-cap outline icons in the accent or chrome; status dots and arrows built from lines.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Chrome 3D objects, wireframes, HUD rings and glitched photography.

motion.transition_physics: Snappy and mechanical: panels slide in 8px to 16px in 160ms; text scrambles for 300ms; glitch bursts last 120ms to 200ms.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover shifts the glitch layers 2px to 4px and fills the frame at 10%; active state inverts to the acid fill.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels that they have entered a cold, fast machine with secrets.

avoid_when: The audience needs calm, plain reading.
The brand is warm or family-friendly.
The page must meet a strict accessibility audit with no motion.

modifiers.how: Remove the cuts and glitch; use hairlines at 8% white and one accent.
Swap acid green for pink and violet and add a sun and a perspective grid.
Reduce to a mono grid in one phosphor colour.

pack.why: A technical, square-cap line family that matches clipped panels and HUD labels.

ground.why: Cybercore renders a wireframe floor that runs to a hard sun on the horizon.
